meta.title: gVisor contribution map
meta.scope: All open upstream PRs by tamird, plus selected pending implementation branches and external capacity blockers. Diagnostic and obsolete validation branches are omitted.
meta.edgeDirection: Prerequisite → dependent. Integration membership is listed in details and excluded from dependency reach.
meta.dependencyNotes: Dependencies are curated from source interfaces, PR descriptions and validated workstreams. Review/preparation waits appear as status, not dependency edges. Historical Docker, stress and Buildkite pilots are omitted; their branches/evidence are preserved. Landed prerequisites are not active blockers.

nodes.title: Build plugins with the selected C toolchain
nodes.summary: Open after the contributor-approved documentation revision at 0c229c451. Patch payloads are byte-identical to validated 827c20885: both static AMD64 binaries and archive-backed Cgo backtrace pass, and the canonical audit accepts all 184 dependencies. GNU compatibility was checked on the hosted coordinator; no new hermetic remote-action result is claimed. Initial PR checks are running.

nodes.title: Select newer Linux headers
nodes.summary: Uses the LLVM migration and 0.8.24 header supplier API, absent upstream. Record the dependency on hermetic-toolchains; isolate the LLVM update/header patch stack and obtain contributor review. Do not open the current 10-commit branch as an independent change. Integrated native/GNU/musl/BPF/static-parent compile and 212-entry audit evidence is retained.

nodes.title: Declare clang-tidy in Bazel
nodes.summary: Refreshed on current master at 94dcc03a1 with unchanged tool-migration source. The previous direct-include failures are superseded by merged #15119 and the passing full clang gate. Root is validating the current canonical catalog and GNU smoke before final contributor review. Prior integrated full lint produced 369 successful reports across 360 owners; five Actions were fresh and the remainder reused.

nodes.title: Keep syscall XML outside overlays
nodes.summary: Contributor-approved reporting correction held for passed-descriptor support.

nodes.title: Wait for checkpointed containers to resume logging
nodes.summary: The reviewed polling fix is published; its focused regression passed. Contributor-approved and published. Focused original checkpoint regression e422 passed; integrated, source reviewed.

nodes.title: Declare process-test worker memory
nodes.summary: Current branch contains 178 qualification commits. Extract the three-line budget on the smallest supported source base. Its memory argument requires the unpublished syscall memory forwarding from rbe-syscall-memory; upstream syscall_test has no memory parameter. Present supplier and declaration for contributor review. Original 300MB guest reached 1816/1816 threads; original five-case ptrace owner passes at1GB without observer.

nodes.title: Declare socket-stress resources
nodes.summary: Current branch contains 179 qualification commits. Extract the three-line declaration, with syscall memory forwarding plus #15131 host-nofile support as real prerequisites. No dependency on the independent processes budget is needed. Obtain contributor review. All8 hostnet shards/33 cases pass with131072 descriptors and1GB; native port-allocation failure is separate.

nodes.title: Keep cgroup unit tests independent of the host
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Integrated default and race cgroup units passed; host cgroup and DBus dependencies are removed from unit fixtures.

nodes.title: Declare network test setup
nodes.summary: Contributor-approved subject to immediate cleanup-owned unlock. The signed correction is published and the complete qualified sandbox_test owner is validating. Prior owning Go namespace-suite evidence is root-only; separate Python nobody results are not credited to this fixture.

nodes.title: Parse Docker test flags before checking the client
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Corrects flag initialization in 18 TestMain functions. Both affected client entrypoints reproduce before and pass after using the existing declared Docker client interface.

nodes.title: Builder-free public CI qualification
nodes.summary: Historical ordinary-systrap baseline plus the socket correction passed 653 of 655 owners. The iptables large-payload fixture passes native Linux and both systrap owners. MQ unlink permissions now pass all 17 cases in all three owners. These targeted results do not establish a complete combined-head run.

nodes.title: Set remote action concurrency
nodes.summary: Current branch contains188 qualification commits. Extract provider configuration/default32-job change with its owning RBE config; no runtime revalidation needed for the already-proven flag placement. Obtain contributor review for source/config publication. Explicit32-job plugin proof and subsequent full-lane runs pass; source/record reviewed.

nodes.title: Newer hosted Linux kernel
nodes.summary: Supported worker selection is unresolved. Existing kernel defects still affect host-network and filesystem tests.

nodes.title: Hosted KVM capacity
nodes.summary: Current worker has no /dev/kvm; supported hosted route requested.

nodes.title: Rootless TUN permissions
nodes.summary: Provider issue closed, deployment expected October1; actual rootless networking is not yet revalidated.

nodes.title: Worker output-buffer ownership
nodes.summary: Provider fix closed, deployment expected October1. Connection to historical corrupted language logs is unverified.

nodes.title: ARM64 Firecracker capacity
nodes.summary: Scheduler reports no ARM64 Firecracker executors. Ordinary ARM64 OCI execution works.

nodes.title: Hosted vhost-net device
nodes.summary: Actual root AMD64 worker returns ENOENT for /dev/vhost-net. Plugin build passes, plugin runtime remains blocked.

nodes.title: Match Linux message-queue unlink permissions
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Native, directfs and shared owners each pass all 17 MQ cases with zero skips; existing Nogo passes. Corrects sticky-root unlink ownership checks.

nodes.title: Fix iptables replacement counter counts
nodes.summary: The reviewed counter-count fixture correction is published. Keep unrelated native socket/extension failures visible; they do not block this case-specific correction. Contributor-approved and published. LargeReplacePayload passes native and both systrap owners; full systrap17PASS each.

nodes.title: Allow netfilter options on non-raw sockets
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Both IPv4 systrap owners pass 36 cases; all three IPv6 owners pass 21 cases; Nogo passes ARM64 and AMD64. Native OriginalDstErrors and missing mark/CT extensions remain separate failures.

nodes.title: Honor DAC capabilities in mq_open
nodes.summary: The DAC capability correction passes all 19 cases on native Linux, systrap DirectFS, and systrap shared-gofer, with no failures or skips. MQ and mqfs Nogo also pass. The before run passed natively and failed the two intended capability cases in each gVisor configuration. Ready for contributor review; no PR is open.

nodes.title: Copy netlink memberships in complete words
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Short-buffer regression fails before and passes after. With the independent rename fixture fix, complete owners pass: native 62 cases with 11 existing skips; both gVisor variants 67 cases with 6 existing skips each. Netlink Nogo passes ARM64 and AMD64.

nodes.title: Lower loopback before testing rename events
nodes.summary: The reviewed lower-before-rename fixture correction is published. No dependency on membership-copy fix. Contributor-approved and published. With the independent membership-copy fix, all three complete owners pass with the existing skips and no failures.

nodes.title: Check Linux filesystem reconfiguration effects
nodes.summary: The reviewed expectation correction is published with precise single-case native/directfs/shared proof. Do not claim whole-owner or Linux6.15 detached-mount coverage. Contributor-approved and published. Three actual uncached passes, no skips; prior exactcase has two expectation failures.

nodes.title: Update the LLVM supplier to 0.8.24
nodes.summary: The Linux-header selection uses this supplier version atop the combined LLVM migration. Extract and review this stack before independent header publication; integrated validation does not establish contributor approval.

nodes.title: Extract the shared RBE configuration
nodes.summary: This published integration owns rbe-common and the syscall worker-property interface used by later memory/concurrency declarations. It is not a standalone ready PR. Extract the provider configuration and worker interface for contributor review; public runtime qualification remains partial.

nodes.title: Forward syscall worker memory budgets
nodes.summary: The processes and socket-stress declarations require this optional memory argument and test.EstimatedMemory forwarding, absent from current upstream. The memory-accounting correction passed its scoped runtime validation. Extract/review the supplier with its shared RBE property interface before publishing dependent declarations.

nodes.title: Apply devpts mount options to slave PTYs
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. SetMode passes native and fails then passes both gVisor variants. Each complete gVisor PTY owner passes 113 cases with one existing skip; devpts unit and Nogo pass. Native PTY timing remains a separate failure.

nodes.title: Retry each exhausted stress-test connection
nodes.summary: Contributor-reviewed and published. Preserves one delayed retry per connection. Complete native, directfs and shared stress owners each pass 33 cases with zero skips across eight shards; all 24 remote attempts are uncached.
